new_theorem.statement: For any real symmetric indefinite 3x3 A with all three eigenvalue magnitudes >=1, G~N(0,Sigma) with lambda_min(Sigma)>=v0>0, and arbitrary independent random vector M, ||p_((G+M)^T A (G+M))||_inf <=1/(2sqrt(2)v0). In particular v0=1/12 gives <=3sqrt(2).
new_theorem.scope: Gaussian core plus arbitrary independent location mixture; not arbitrary rough product laws.

explicit_witness_test.matrix: B=I-2nn^T with n=(1,2,3)/sqrt(14); A_m=T_m B T_m^T
explicit_witness_test.source_law: Each of 3m physical coordinates has density 1 on a centered interval of length 1-1/m and a satellite interval of length 1/m centered at sqrt(m).
explicit_witness_test.properties: Exact cap one; root-m gap; non-Lindeberg; expected total satellite visits=3; bank limit N(0,I/12)+iid Poisson(1).

partner_applied.use: Condition on arbitrary random shift M; deterministic Gaussian translation cannot increase the centered comparator norm. Quantitative noncentral loss with D>=12 gives the strict Poisson bound.

required_source_applied.use: For the actual finite physical eigenframe V_m=T_mO, row leverage=1/m and residual=0, giving |Phi_m(t)|<=min(1,(4pi)^(3/2)|t|^(-3/2)); its L1 mass 24pi upgrades weak convergence to uniform all-output density convergence.

unresolved_implication: A sharp or divergent witness must do more than independently translate a three-dimensional Gaussian core with covariance floor 1/12. Remaining mechanisms include depletion/non-location deformation of that core, dependence between macroscopic and Gaussian components, several shared non-collinear macroscopic rows before aggregation, or interacting additional active spectrum.
next_step: Stress the first non-location non-Lindeberg limit: compound-Poisson random linear/quadratic deformation coupled to a diffuse Gaussian carrier, while preserving independent physical cap-one sources and exact target spectrum.
